tasks.gr7-personal-social-wellbeing-t2: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on personal and social well-being covering peer influence, substance abuse awareness, online safety, communication, and empathy. Ask learners to choose assertive responses, evaluate digital risk, and identify safe, respectful behaviour.
tasks.gr7-physical-education-t2: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on physical education covering sport-specific skills, passing and receiving, stamina, rules, leadership, and fair competition. Include modified-match scenarios where learners apply tactics and rule understanding.
tasks.gr7-creative-arts-t2: Generate Grade 7 Life Skills multiple-choice items on creative arts covering poster design, characterisation, song structure, movement motifs, and audience awareness. Ask learners to choose design and performance decisions that improve message and impact.
